# Rejectly.pro — ATS Resume Checker

> Free ATS resume checker and AI-powered resume optimization platform. Check your resume's ATS compatibility score, identify missing keywords, and get optimized resumes that pass Applicant Tracking Systems.

## ATS Resume Checker

Rejectly.pro's free ATS resume checker analyzes your resume against 40+ criteria used by major Applicant Tracking Systems including Workday, Greenhouse, Taleo, and Lever. Upload your resume to get an instant ATS compatibility score with detailed feedback on formatting, keywords, and structure.

- **URL**: https://rejectly.pro/ats-check
- **Features**: Instant ATS score, keyword gap analysis, formatting checks, actionable fixes
- **Price**: Free (no credit card required)

## Core Features

- **Free ATS Resume Checker**: Upload your resume and get an instant ATS compatibility score analyzing 40+ criteria used by Fortune 500 ATS systems
- **AI Resume Analysis**: GPT-4 powered analysis that identifies keyword gaps, formatting issues, and optimization opportunities
- **ATS Optimization**: Ensures resumes pass automated screening systems with 85% higher pass rate
- **Job Matching**: AI compares your resume against job descriptions to calculate compatibility and identify skill gaps
- **Bullet Point Rewriting**: AI rewrites achievement-focused bullet points tailored to the target role
- **Cover Letter Generator**: Creates personalized, job-specific cover letters in 30 seconds
- **Alternative Role Suggestions**: Recommends other suitable positions based on your skills and experience
- **ATS-Optimized Resume Builder**: Clean, professional templates designed to pass ATS filters
- **Multi-language Support**: Works with 50+ languages

## Who It's For

- Job seekers who want to check their resume's ATS compatibility
- Active job seekers applying to multiple positions
- Career changers transitioning to new roles
- Professionals frustrated with low interview response rates
- New graduates and entry-level candidates navigating ATS-heavy application processes

## How the ATS Resume Checker Works

1. Upload your resume (PDF, DOCX, or plain text)
2. Optionally paste the job description you're targeting
3. Receive AI-powered ATS analysis with compatibility score, keyword gaps, and recommendations
4. Download your optimized, ATS-friendly resume
